# Copywriting

`aaj-copywriting` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Content & Copy
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/aaj-copywriting/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Is this copy clear, concrete and defensible enough to publish, and which claims still need proof?

**Inputs:** The asset and its one job, the audience, the positioning (or the raw inputs for it), the competitive alternative, and any proof — numbers, named customers, specifics

**Output:** Drafted copy laddered to the positioning, a scored read on clarity/concreteness/claim-defensibility, and a list of claims that still need proof

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill aaj-copywriting`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/aaj-copywriting/resources/copy-scorer.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/aaj-copywriting/resources/copy-scorer.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON. It can read an input file you name on the command line; it reads nothing else.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It applies fixed word lists and readability rules to the text you paste. It cannot see how buyers respond, so a high score is not a conversion forecast.
- It cannot tell whether the message is right. Copy can score well and still miss the positioning or break the brand voice; judge that yourself.
- Concreteness counts numbers and names, not whether they are true. A made-up figure raises the score, so every number still needs proof on file.
- Short copy gets an indicative score only (it wants about 25 words or more); a two-word input scored 100. Score a full section, not a headline on its own.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns the page checks the draft against the positioning and the brand voice, and the founder confirms the proof behind every number and named customer before it ships.
